title: Requirements, baselines and change sets
description: Use when handling LPM requirements (requisitos) and scope (escopo): create, edit, group, link requirements, check drift, reconcile orphans, review change sets before publishing, publish a baseline on owner order. Not for roadmap items or change requests (use lpm-roadmap).
doneWhen: Requirements match the request; an owner-ordered baseline is current with no pending delta.
authorityCeiling: Reads [A]; scope edits [C]; change-set approval and baselines [O].

references.loadWhen: playbook scope-status: status, drift or traceability (read-only)
playbook edit-requirement: edit, link, regroup or set the status of a requirement
playbook remove-requirement: remove a requirement (obsolete or delete)
playbook groups-and-orphans: requirement groups, or attach orphan requirements
playbook change-set: create a live change set, or move it to review/draft
playbook change-set-decision: the owner approves or rejects a change set
playbook proposal: propose rewrites or copies (live scope untouched)
playbook publish-baseline: publish a baseline on the owner's order
playbook baseline-records: rename, restore or delete a baseline (owner)
